senses.gloss:
तिल् 1. तिल्, cl. 1. P. तेलति, &c., to go
or move; [cf. rt. तिल्ल्.]

तिल् 2. तिल् (probably an artificial rt. fr.
तिल below), cl. 6. 10. P. तिलति, तेलयति,
&c., to be unctuous or greasy; to oil or anoint.

तिल्ल् तिल्ल्, cl. 1. P. तिल्लति, &c., to go or
move; (a various reading for 1. तिल्.)

तिल, अस्, m. the sesamum plant (Sesamum Indi-
cum) which bears an oily seed; the seed of this
plant (much used in Oriental cookery); a mole or
spot compared to a seed of sesamum; a small particle
or portion as much as a sesamum-seed [cf. कृष्ण-
तिल and चर्म-तिल]; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a chapter
of the Purāṇa-sarva-sva.
—तिल-कट, अम्, n. the farina
of sesamum.
—तिल-कल्क, अस्, m. dough made of
ground sesamum.
—तिलकल्क-ज, अस् or अम्, m. or
n. (?), oil-cake made of the sediment of ground
sesamum.
—तिल-कालक, अस्, m. a mole, a dark spot
under the skin; a disease of the penis in which the
fleshy parts become black and die off; (अस्, आ, अम्),
having a mole or mark.
—तिल-किट्ट, अम्, n. the
caky sediment of sesamum after the oil is pressed out.
—तिल-खलि, इस् or ई f. oil-cake made from sesa-
mum.
—तिल-गञ्जि-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a place
mentioned in the Rasika-ramaṇa by Raghu-nātha.
[]
—तिल-ग्राम, अस्, m., N. of a Grāma or township.
—तिल-चित्र-पत्त्रक, अस्, m. a kind of bulbous
plant.
—तिल-चूर्ण, अम्, n. sesamum ground and
pounded.
—तिल-तण्डुलक, अम्, n. an embrace
(as agreeable as rice mixed with sesamum).
—तिल-
तेजा, f. a kind of plant.
—तिल-तैल, अम्, n. sesa-
mum-oil.
—तिलदेश्वर-तीर्थ (˚द-ईश्˚), अम्, n.,
N. of a Tīrtha; [cf. तिलकेश्वर-तीर्थ.]
—तिल-
द्वादशी, f. a festival occurring on the twelfth day of
a particular month.
—तिल-धेनु, उस्, f. sesamum
made up in the shape of a cow for the purpose of
being presented to Brāhmans &c.
—तिलधेनु-
दान, अम्, n., N. of a chapter of the Vārāha-
Purāṇa.
—तिलन्-तुद, अस्, आ, अम्, bruising sesamum-
seed, a sesamum-grinder, one who extracts oil out of
sesamum-seed; [cf. तिल-पीड.]
—तिल-पर्ण, अस्, m.
turpentine; (ई), f. the sandal tree, Pterocarpus Santa-
linus; frankincense; turpentine; (अम्), n. the leaf of
the Tila tree; sandal-wood.
—तिल-पर्णिका, f. or तिल-
पर्णिक or तिल-पर्णक, अम्, n. red sanders, sandal-
wood.
—तिल-पिच्चट, अम्, n. (पिच्चट = पिष्टक),
a sort of sweetmeat made chiefly of ground sesamum.
—तिल-पिञ्ज, अस्, m. barren sesamum, bearing no
blossom or yielding a seed which gives no oil; white
sesamum; [cf. तिल-पेज, तिल्पिञ्ज, तैल-पिञ्ज.]
—तिल-पीड, अस्, m. = तिलन्-तुद; [cf. तैल-
पीड.]
—तिल-पुष्पक, Terminalia Bellerica (वि-
भीतक).
—तिल-पेज, अस्, m. barren sesamum;
[cf. तिल-पिञ्ज.]
—तिल-भार, आस्, m. pl., N. of a
race.
—तिल-भाविनी, f. jasmine.
—तिल-भृष्ट,
अम्, n. fried sesamum-seed.
—तिल-मय, अस्, ई, अम्,
made of or prepared from sesamum, abounding with
sesamum.
—तिल-मयूर, अस्, m. a species of pea-
cock.
—तिल-मिश्र, अस्, आ, अम्, mixed with sesamum.
—तिल-रस, अस्, m. sesamum-oil.
—तिल-वत्स, अस्,
आ, अम्, Ved. having sesamum-seed (as it were) for
children.
—तिल-व्रतिन्, ई, इनी, इ, eating only sesa-
mum-seeds in consequence of a vow.
—तिल-शस्, ind.
in pieces as small as sesamum-seeds.
—तिल-सम्-
बद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, mixed with sesamum-oil.
—तिल-
स्नेह, अस्, m. oil, especially of sesamum.
—तिल-
होम, अम्, n. burnt-offering of sesamum.
—तिलाङ्-
कित-दल (˚ल-अङ्˚), अस्, m. a kind of bulbous
plant, = तैल-कन्द.
—तिलाढक? (˚ल-आढ्˚), N.
of a monastery; (also read तिलटक, तिलढाक,
तिल-शाक्य.) — तिलान्न (˚ल-अन्˚), अम्, n. rice with
sesamum-seeds.
—तिलापत्या (˚ल-अप्˚), f. a plant
bearing a small pungent seed, Nigella Indica.
—तिलाम्बु (˚ल-अम्˚), उ, n. water with sesamum.
—तिलोत्तमा (˚ल-उत्˚), f., N. of an Apsaras; a
form of Dākṣāyaṇī; N. of a woman.
—तिलोदक
(˚ल-उद्˚), अम्, n. sesamum-seeds and water (as an
oblation).
—तिलौदन (˚ल-ओद्˚), अम्, n. a dish of
milk, rice, and sesamum.

तिलक, अस्, m. a species of tree with beautiful
flowers, (so called either because it is similar in some
way to the sesamum plant, or because it is used as an
ornament like the mark on the forehead); a plant
growing near water; a freckle, a natural mark under
the skin (compared to a seed of sesamum); a kind of
eruption of the skin; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a mark or marks
made with coloured earths, sandal-wood, or unguents,
upon the forehead and between the eyebrows, either as
an ornament or a sectarial distinction; the ornament
of anything (used in comp. to express greatness or
distinction, e. g. त्रैलोक्य-तिलक, the ornament of
the three worlds, i. e. a distinguished personage);
(अस्), m. the burden of a song, = ध्रुवक; a
species of horse; N. of a son of Pra-dyota; N. of a
prince of Kampanā; (आ), f. a kind of necklace;
(अम्), n. the bladder; the lungs; black sochal salt,
a factitious salt containing sulphur and iron &c.; a
disease, the appearance of dark spots on the skin,
unattended with inflammation; alliteration; a kind
of metre consisting of four lines of six syllables each;
[cf. ऊर्ध्व-तिलकिन्, एण-तिलक, ख-त्˚, वसन्त-
त्˚.]
—तिलक-राज, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—तिलक-
व्रत, अम्, n., N. of a chapter of the second part
of the Bhaviṣya-Purāṇa, treating of ceremonies.
—तिलक-सिंह, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—तिलका-
श्रय (˚क-आश्˚), अस्, m. the forehead (‘the receptacle
[]
of the Tilaka’).
—तिलकेश्वर-तीर्थ (˚क-ईश्), अम्,
n., N. of a Tīrtha; [cf. तिलदेश्वर-तीर्थ.]
तिलकक, अस्, m., N. of a man.

तिलकाय, nom. A. तिलकायते, &c., to form the
Tilaka mark on the forehead, to ornament.

तिलकित, अस्, आ, अम्, marked with the Tilaka, or-
namented; freckled, spotted.

तिलकिन्, ई, इनी, इ, marked with the Tilaka; freckled,
spotted.

तिलु, an adj. derived by Sāy. fr. तिल, and meaning
‘fertile,’ ‘rich;’ [cf. तिल्विल below.]
तिल्पिञ्ज, अस्, m., Ved. = तिल-पिञ्ज, q. v.

तिल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, suited for the cultivation of
sesamum, grown with sesamum; (अम्), n. a field of
sesamum.

तिल्व or तिल्वक, अस्, m. the tree Symplocus
Racemosa, = इङ्गुदी, Terminalia Catappa.

तिल्विल, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having a fertile soil,
prolific, rich; [cf. इभ्य-तिल्विल and धान्य-त्˚.]

तिल्विलाय, nom. A. तिल्विलायते, &c., Ved. to be
fertile or rich, to cause fertility of soil.

तिलकनिज तिलकनिज, आस्, m. pl., N. of a
race.

तिलिङ्ग तिलिङ्ग, N. of a place mentioned
in the Kāka-rudra-saṃvāda.

तिलिङ्गिल तिलिङ्गिल, आस्, m. pl., N. of a
people; (also तिमिङ्गिल, तिलेङ्गल.)

तिलित्स तिलित्स or तिलिच्छ, अस्, m. a large
snake; (according to some = Gokhura; according
to others = the Boa or Boa Constrictor.)
तिल्पिलिक तिल्पिलिक, अम्, n. = तिर्पिरिक.
